name: screenshotagent
description: Find, capture, refresh, mark up and review the screenshots ScreenshotAgent keeps up to date for your docs, support and marketing pages.

interface.longDescription: ScreenshotAgent keeps the screenshots in your docs, help center and marketing pages up to date. Every screenshot your team captures goes into a searchable library, indexed by what is on it, so from chat you can find one by describing it and see it inline. You can capture a new page, including pages behind your app's login once that login is saved to a project, and recapture screenshots after a deploy. You can mark up a screenshot (circle, highlight, arrow, callout, blur or browser frame), compare a new capture with the live one and approve it, and get stable embed links that always show the published image. ScreenshotAgent captures sites on the internet, not your desktop, localhost or private networks. Project setup, site logins, visibility, schedules and deleting screenshots stay in the ScreenshotAgent dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Find the screenshot of our pricing page and show it to me.
Recapture our onboarding screenshots, we just shipped a new flow.
Is anything waiting for my approval?

positive.description: Capture a new page and wait for it
positive.prompt: Capture https://example.com and call it Example home.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one private screenshot named Example home, polls its capture status until it is ready, and shows the finished image inline. It does not call recapture for the first capture.

positive.description: Find a screenshot by what is on it
positive.prompt: Find the Example home screenshot and show me its details.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching screenshots inline as thumbnails, then the Example home screenshot's detail: its URL, status and recent versions. It does not start a new capture.
Queues a recapture of only that screenshot, reports the captures it uses, polls until the new version is ready, and shows it inline.

positive.prompt: Add a browser frame to the Example home screenshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues a browser-frame annotation of the latest capture, polls until it completes, and reports the new annotated version. The original capture is kept.
Lists the current plan or trial and each paid plan with the monthly price and included captures returned by the tool. It does not start checkout until the user picks a plan.

negative.description: Desktop screenshots are out of scope
negative.prompt: Take a screenshot of my desktop.

negative.description: Localhost and internal network addresses cannot be captured

publication.release_notes: Shorter skill that defers to the live MCP tool descriptions, so server updates no longer conflict with it. Images and search results show inline instead of as Markdown image links. Adds listing support, privacy and terms URLs, more specific capability labels, and review test cases.
